entries.6d5e00f996c31081: Its mission is to contribute to the creation of a comfortable future society, aiming for disaster prevention of the national land against various natural disasters and conservation of a rich natural environment, and working to develop and disseminate new technologies and construction methods. Built around its wave-dissipating foundation block construction technology, it lists as challenges expanding earnings from existing businesses through the formwork rental business and product sales business, developing new businesses and new products with added value, selecting and concentrating its existing products, and maintaining and strengthening its network of partner companies while building new cooperative and alliance relationships.
